name: Guatemala (1858–1871)
description: Seven horizontal stripes of blue, white, red, yellow, red, white and blue, the central yellow stripe three times as wide as the others.
history: Second flag of the Carrera era, adopted on 31 May 1858, arranging the blue, white, red and yellow of the 1851 flag as symmetrical horizontal stripes around a broad yellow centre. After the Liberal Revolution the original Central American colours were restored on 17 August 1871, as vertical stripes with a new coat of arms.
